summary: Shipped 1.3.0 with the LoRA and upscale pickers dead in Model Settings (8184709b: MpiDropdown/MpiTreePicker portalled to body at MOUNT, so a picker built inside a body-mounted MpiOverlay before show() was swept into the overlay stash). Same surface broke once before (MPI-356: overlay in the #tool-container stacking context painting under the picker, plus an exponential open() reopen loop). Nothing runs at release today - release:check is static file consistency, CI dispatches a build, and the 80 green unit tests plus 8 desktop specs are never gated. This card adds desktop smoke specs for that bug class and makes both suites a release gate.

Implementation started. Plan approved by the user: launch.js helper, popup-contract.spec.js (primitive contract, reproduces the 8184709b probe), model-settings-popup.spec.js (real surface, also guards the MPI-356 storm), workspace-sweep.spec.js (breadth), then the SKILL.md release gate. CI workflow deliberately deferred - npm ci cannot resolve @cubric/connector (file:../Cubric-Studio/packages/connector) on a lone checkout.

Shipped in 7104a24a. Three desktop specs on a shared launch helper, and npm test + npm run test:desktop are now a mandatory step in mpi-version-bump step 6 with a do-not-approve-on-red note in mpi-release gate 1. Suites 417/0 unit and 17/17 desktop. Every assertion proven able to fail by sabotage-and-revert: the eager mount-time portal restored in MpiDropdown and MpiTreePicker each fail popup-contract independently, a throw in MpiGalleryBlock.setup fails only the gallery sweep test. The open()-count assertion had to be REWRITTEN to be non-vacuous - the MPI-356 subscription is gated on _isOpen, which open() sets last, so a first open can never re-enter and the assertion passed with the guard deleted; it now changes state.availableLoras under an already-open overlay, where removing _rescanning gives 3 and also removing assetService _same() gives 7792. Testing docs split out of DEVELOPMENT.md (over the 200-line rule) into docs/testing.md. CI deliberately deferred to MPI-444 - npm ci cannot resolve the @cubric/connector file: dependency on a lone checkout.
Archived out of board.columns.done to .agents/mpi-kanban/tasks/_archived/MPI-443/ (workspace preserved intact). mpi-archive run 2026-08-21.
